description.value:
Requires Attunement

Open Light Bowgun in the Toolbox

Ammo DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier

Features

Mastery (Slow)

If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

Rapid Fire

Bonus Action.

When you take the Attack action and attack with this weapon, you can make one additional attack with it as a Bonus Action.

▸ Upgrade — Rapid Fire Upgrade I

Bonus Action.

When you use your Rapid Fire feature to attack as a Bonus Action, you can make two additional attacks instead of one.

▸ Upgrade — Rapid Fire Upgrade II

Bonus Action.

When you use your Rapid Fire feature to attack as a Bonus Action, you can make three additional attacks instead of two.

Overheat

When you resolve an attack made with your Rapid Fire feature, you gain 1 stack of Overheat. Resolve that attack first (applying any Overheat stacks you already have), then gain the new stack; the attack that just granted the stack does not take that new stack's penalty.

While you have one or more stacks, attacks with this weapon deal 3 less damage for each stack (to a minimum of 1 damage from the weapon's damage roll and modifiers combined, before other effects that add damage dice). This penalty applies to every later attack with this weapon before the start of your next turn — including attacks from Action Surge, Extra Attack, and reactions — not only Rapid Fire shots. Overheat stacks last until the start of your next turn.

Against area ammunition (such as Pierce, Spread, or Explosive/Sticky Ammo), the penalty reduces the weapon damage of that shot for each creature affected. It does not change save DCs or non-damage effects (conditions, healing from Recover Ammo, and similar).

▸ Upgrade — Overheat Upgrade I

Overheat's damage penalty is 2 per stack instead of 3.

Magazine

The weapon holds a maximum of 6 loaded rounds at a time. When the magazine reaches 0, you must reload it before you can fire again.

▸ Upgrade — Magazine Upgrade I

Your magazine capacity increases to 8 rounds of standard ammunition (Normal, Pierce, or Spread).

▸ Upgrade — Magazine Upgrade II

Your magazine capacity increases to 10 rounds.

▸ Upgrade — Magazine Upgrade III

Your magazine capacity increases to 12 rounds.

Reload

Action.

You can fully reload your magazine using an Action or a Bonus Action. When you do so, you choose the type of ammunition the weapon will contain.

Special Ammo

Due to barrel pressure limits, you can load a maximum of 2 Special Ammo rounds into the magazine during a reload. Once these are expended, you must reload to switch back to another ammunition type.

▸ Upgrade — Special Ammo Upgrade I

Your magazine can now hold up to 4 Special Ammo rounds.

▸ Upgrade — Special Ammo Upgrade II

Your magazine can now hold up to 6 Special Ammo rounds.

Wyvernblast

Bonus Action.

As a Bonus Action, you can plant a Wyvernblast charge on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, or shoot it into a creature within 30 feet. When a creature within 5 feet of the charge takes damage from an attack or spell, the charge detonates, dealing [[/r 1d6]] Fire damage to all creatures within 5 feet of it. The charge lasts for 1 minute or until it detonates 3 times. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

▸ Upgrade — Wyvernblast Upgrade I

The damage of your Wyvernblast detonations increases to [[/r 1d8]] Fire damage.

Evading Reload

The weapon is designed to be reloaded using the momentum of your body. Once per turn, if you move at least 15 feet in a straight line, you can reload half your magazine as part of that movement without expending an action. When you do so, choose either standard ammunition (Normal, Pierce, or Spread Ammo) or Special Ammo; you reload a number of rounds equal to half that ammunition type's current magazine capacity (rounded down).

Counter Mine

Reaction.

If a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to embed a Wyvernblast charge directly into the attacker and detonate it instantly. This expends one use of your Wyvernblast and causes all three detonations simultaneously.

Ammunition

Normal Ammo

Deals the weapon's base damage ([[/r 1d4]] Piercing) to a single target.

▸ Upgrade — Normal Ammo Upgrade

Your Normal Ammo now deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Piercing damage.

Pierce Ammo

You fire in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Make a single attack roll and compare it against the AC of each creature in that line. All creatures hit take the weapon's normal damage.

▸ Upgrade — Pierce Ammo Upgrade

Your Pierce Ammo now deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Piercing damage.

Spread Ammo

Instead of making an attack roll, you fire a 10-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Ammo DC. On a failed save, a creature takes [[/r 1d4]] Piercing damage.

▸ Upgrade — Spread Ammo Upgrade

Your Spread Ammo now deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Piercing damage.

Recover Ammo

Instead of taking damage, a willing creature hit by this ammo regains [[/r 1d4]] hit points.

▸ Upgrade — Recover Ammo Upgrade

Your Recover Ammo now restores [[/r 2d4]] + your Proficiency Bonus hit points.

Flaming Ammo

Your attacks with this ammo deal Fire damage instead of Piercing damage.

▸ Upgrade — Flaming Ammo Upgrade

Your Flaming Ammo now deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Fire damage.

Water Ammo

Your attacks with this ammo deal Acid damage instead of Piercing damage.

▸ Upgrade — Water Ammo Upgrade

Your Water Ammo now deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Acid damage.

Thunder Ammo

Your attacks with this ammo deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

▸ Upgrade — Thunder Ammo Upgrade

Your Thunder Ammo now deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Lightning damage.

Freeze Ammo

Your attacks with this ammo deal Cold damage instead of Piercing damage.

▸ Upgrade — Freeze Ammo Upgrade

Your Freeze Ammo now deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] Cold damage.

Poison Ammo

Your attacks with this ammo deal [[/r 1d4]] Poison damage. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Ammo DC or have the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

Paralysis Ammo

Your attacks with this ammo deal [[/r 1d4]] Lightning damage. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Ammo DC. On a failure, it becomes Paralyzed until the end of their next turn.

Explosive/Sticky Ammo

Your attacks with this ammo deal [[/r 1d4]] Fire damage and produce an explosion in a 5-foot radius. Every creature in that area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Ammo DC or suffer [[/r 2d4]] Fire damage and have the Prone condition.

Sleep Ammo

If the target has 50 Hit Points or fewer, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or fall Unconscious for 1 minute, or until it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake.

Dragon Ammo

The attack deals an extra [[/r 2d6]] Necrotic damage, and the target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
